rules: Arial, white background, thin axes; no top/right spines and no grid
square or near-square panels by default
paired observations: gray connecting lines without duplicate individual points; summary mean±SEM
unpaired effect-size plots: light-gray individual points plus focal mean±SEM
model comparisons: gray baselines and focal method in red
bars use fill only and no outline
English and Chinese pages share identical plot/source-data assets
